drivetrain.notes: The official 05/02/24 technical-data sheet lists drive type 'All-wheel drive'.

transmission.notes: The official 05/02/24 RS e-tron GT technical-data sheet lists transmission type '2-speed / automatic'; the press information gives the front motor a single ratio and the rear motor a two-speed transmission.
transmission.name: 2-speed automatic (rear) / single-speed (front)

final_drive_front.notes: Front motor ratio 8.1:1 per the official Audi press information (November 2022).

final_drive_rear.notes: Rear two-speed transmission second gear 8.2:1 per the official Audi press information (November 2022); the analysis models this one rear ratio. First gear (15.6:1) is not encoded.

verification_notes.note: RS e-tron GT (pre-facelift, 440 kW): the official press information gives the front motor 8.1:1 and the rear two-speed transmission 15.6:1 (first) and 8.2:1 (second gear); the 8.057 this row carried had no source. The 05/02/24 technical-data sheet gives all-wheel drive, '2-speed / automatic' and basic tires 245/45 R20 | 285/40 R20. Presales began in mid-February 2021; the facelift RS e-tron GT (500 kW) was orderable from 06/18/2024, so this row covers 2021-2023.

unresolved.reason: The row stores one rear reduction ratio, the second gear (8.2:1) the car normally drives in; in first gear (launch starts, or held in the dynamic driving mode) the rear motor turns 15.6 / 8.2 = 1.9 times faster than the modelled motor order, which the analysis does not model.
The technical-data sheet lists only the basic tires; no official wheel program with the optional 20- and 21-inch sizes was found.
